name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Optional Plex add-in and browser playback resilience. Plex catalogs, Companion connections, metadata/import and .strm export now require the matching optional Plex add-in installed beside the core DLL. Ordinary Jellyfin federation works without it; an absent add-in preserves Plex settings and cached titles without using the wrong protocol. Adaptive web playback tolerates slow HLS segments with bounded buffers, timeouts and retries, while diagnostics omit playback URLs and tokens. Includes everything in 0.0.200.
